final: WITH m AS (SELECT o.dealedge AS side FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault), g AS (SELECT side, COUNT(*) AS c FROM m GROUP BY side), a AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS av FROM g WHERE c IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT g.side, g.c, a.av FROM g JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE g.c > a.av) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_count, AVG(c - av) AS avg_excess FROM k
